# netbox_fhrp_group_assignment (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox fhrp group assignment (`/api/ipam/fhrp-group-assignments/`) by `id` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_fhrp_group_assignment" "example" {
  id = 123
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_fhrp_group_assignment" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/ipam/fhrp-group-assignments/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Fhrp Group (`netbox_fhrp_group`).
- `interface_id` (Number) Interface Id.
- `interface_type` (String) Interface Type.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `priority` (Number) Priority.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
